title: "Salaries and Sports: The Financial Effect of College Athletics"
description: >-
  Do college athletes earn more after graduation? Log-log regressions with individual,
  time and sport fixed effects on a 2012 to 2019 person-year dataset find varsity athletes
  earning less than non-athletes on average, with female varsity athletes faring better
  than male ones.
